name: opensdr-mcp
description: Open-source AI SDR: prospecting, email waterfall, buying signals, grounded outreach and safe campaign staging.
long_description:
OpenSDR gives your assistant the toolkit of a sales development rep, using your own API keys with no markup.

- **Find prospects** that match your ideal customer profile (Apollo).
- **Find and verify work emails** with a cost-aware waterfall: Apollo → Hunter → free local checks.
- **Spot buying signals** (funding, hiring, leadership changes) with a source link for every one (Tavily or Exa).
- **Draft grounded outreach**: every personalized line cites a sourced fact.
- **Stage campaigns and CRM records** in Instantly and HubSpot, only after you approve a preview. Campaigns are created as drafts and never activated.

Every key is optional. With no keys, OpenSDR runs in demo mode on fictional data so you can try every tool first.
